pc_changelog:
v8.1.0 — Unified Window Restore, Scrollbar Removal & Search Improvements

• New: Reverted separate MiniShelfWindow, fully restored the highly reliable unified MainWindow layout for all clipboard modes.
• New: Search capability is now fully visible and active inside the mini flyshelf clipboard.
• Improved: Vertical scrollbar is dynamically hidden in Mini Mode to prevent visual clutter in tight spaces.
• Fixed: Added mode-driven check to ensure the mini clipboard always opens directly in standard clipboard list mode.
